item.title: Former Lake Forest Academy therapist who said she was in love with student pleads guilty to violating no-contact order
item.description: A former Lake Forest Academy therapist, who prosecutors said was in love with a male juvenile student and hosted him for sleepovers, has pleaded guilty to violating a court no-contact order with him.
